name: tungsten-rain
title: Tungsten Rain — Orbital Kinetic Bombardment
author: fess932
description: A storage ring around the planet keeps 100 kg tungsten rods circulating at 0.01c (107 kt each). Firing is just a skipped turn at one deflector station. Fireball and shockwave like a nuke — no radiation, no warhead, no mercy. The projectile is not accelerated by the shot; the projectile lives accelerated.
